title: SA-HERV expression across hESC, senescent and reprogrammed lineages
description: This study comprises 18 RNA-seq libraries spanning six cell groups (three biological replicates each): human embryonic stem cells (H9), young and senescent mesenchymal progenitor cells (MPCs) differentiated from H9, human bone marrow-derived mesenchymal progenitor cells (HMPC), and induced pluripotent stem cells reprogrammed from young or senescent MPCs without clonal selection (Y-IPS and O-IPS). Reads were aligned to the GRCh38.p14 reference genome.
